gates.blocks_boot_when: the combination is held at power-on
gates.evidence: polls the scan buffer at 0x18012ac8 up to 100 times, enabling and disabling interrupts around a scan tick each time, and returns 1 once the pattern (+0x0 == 0xa0 and +0x10 == 0x100) has held for 31 consecutive samples: the counter starts at zero and the cmp r5,#0x1e at 0x2a20 is tested before the increment, so the return happens on the 31st match
gates.name: recovery key combination

gates.blocks_boot_when: the image declares any other entry address
gates.evidence: a literal-pool word in the orchestrator, compared with the value FUN_00002af0 returned from the container scan
gates.name: selected entry equals the bootloader's constant
gates.requirement: the SN_FWIN entry pointer must be exactly 0x60011000

gates.blocks_boot_when: the application set the magic and reset
gates.evidence: reads 0x20000ffc and compares it with 0x73207320; when equal it clears the word and returns 1, so the flag is one-shot
gates.name: software bootloader-entry flag

gates.blocks_boot_when: the stored guard word does not equal the sum
gates.evidence: sums every 32-bit word of 0x10000..0x7c000 in 0x1000-byte pages and requires the final word to equal the sum; an all-0xff first page also fails
gates.name: application-region word-sum

handoff.entry_parked_in_basis: vector slot 7, the first Reserved slot, of the table VTOR points at when FUN_00007fa8 runs. The runtime value of VTOR is not a static property of the image, so no fixed address is claimed.
handoff.mechanism: copy then system reset, not a branch
handoff.reset_request: AIRCR = (AIRCR & 0x700) | 0x05fa0000 + 4, i.e. VECTKEY with SYSRESETREQ, preserving PRIGROUP

negatives.basis: Searched the 0xf000-byte bootloader at every byte offset for the 32-bit constants 0x428a2f98, 0x6a09e667, 0x67452301, 0xefcdab89, 0xd76aa478, 0x5a827999, 0xedb88320, 0x04c11db7, 0x1021, 0x8408, 0x63636363 and 0x9e3779b9. Only 0xedb88320 at program 0xc78c and 0x8408 at 0xc76c are present, both accounted for by the CRC engine of log 75.
negatives.strength: a search over a fixed constant list. It does not exclude a check whose constants are computed rather than stored.

negatives.basis: Extracted every ASCII run of five or more printable bytes and matched them against ver/sign/rsa/sha/key/auth/roll/devi case variants. The only hits are USB HID descriptor text and '[BLD] CRC Verify PASS!!'.
negatives.finding: no version, signature, key, auth or rollback string found
negatives.strength: a search over strings. A numeric version or rollback comparison would leave no string at all, so this says nothing about one.

negatives.basis: The only USB identity words in the bootloader are 0x0b05 and 0x1b7f, its own vendor and bootloader product IDs, and none of the four gates decompiled for this phase reads an identity.
negatives.finding: no device-ID gate found in the accept expression
negatives.strength: complete for the four gates, which were read in full. Call paths elsewhere in the bootloader were not exhaustively traced.

negatives.basis: The accept expression in FUN_00007ec8 is the four gates listed above and nothing else, and none of the four reads stored configuration.
negatives.strength: complete for the accept expression, silent about the rest of the bootloader.

rules.evidence: orchestrator gate 2, a constant comparison against DAT_00007f98
rules.name: entry pointer is fixed
rules.requirement: SN_FWIN +0x10 must be exactly 0x60011000. The entry image cannot be relocated.

rules.evidence: BootHandoff, scatter-loaded from bootloader program 0xcdfc to 0x18010000, called as (0, entry, 0x10000). The absence of a length test is what makes this a policy rather than a rule.
rules.name: POLICY: keep the entry image inside the copied window
rules.requirement: 0x10000 bytes are copied from the entry address to 0x0 regardless of the record length. No bootloader branch tests whether the record fits: a longer record would simply have its tail left uncopied. Keeping the image inside the window is therefore a conservative policy for a builder, not a recovered bootloader requirement.

rules.evidence: orchestrator gate 4; base and length both read from bootloader constants rather than assumed
rules.name: application word-sum must be correct
rules.requirement: the final word of the application region must equal the 32-bit sum of every preceding word in it.

rules.name: every active record's chunked-CRC sum must be correct
rules.requirement: FUN_0000511c scans all eight record slots and verifies each slot whose length is nonzero.

rules.name: the entry image's initial SP must be in RAM
rules.requirement: FUN_00005240 dereferences the entry pointer and requires the first word to fall in an observed RAM range.

rules.name: SN_FWIN magic and the container chain must be intact
rules.requirement: FUN_00008000 walks the boot-priority table, checks the SN_FWIN magic and only then validates the entry and records.

unresolved: What makes address 0 writable is not established from these bytes. BootHandoff copies there and then resets, so a RAM or remap window must be aliased at 0, but the register that arranges it is not identified.
The recovery scan pattern (+0x0 == 0xa0, +0x10 == 0x100) is read from a RAM buffer the bootloader's own scan tick fills. Which physical keys produce it is not established.
Any ROM or first-stage condition ahead of this bootloader is still unexamined.
